name: Dext Prepare
pricing: From ~$25.21/mo annual (250 docs, 5 users); partner plans per client
summary: Capture, extract, and publish receipts and bills to Xero/QuickBooks (Dext Prepare / Dext Business).
useCase: Kill manual receipt entry for 50+ small clients.

name: Hubdoc
pricing: Included with qualifying Xero plans; standalone ~$12/mo
summary: Document fetch and OCR for Xero practices.
useCase: Auto-pull utility and bank statements monthly.

name: Booke AI
summary: AI bookkeeper inside QBO/Xero: daily categorization, OCR, exception review.
useCase: Reconcile uncategorized transactions and auto-chase clients.

name: Docyt
summary: AI-native accounting ERP for multi-location hospitality and retail, with continuous reconciliation and a closing agent.

name: Vic.ai
summary: Autonomous invoice processing and AP approvals.
useCase: Process high-volume AP for larger clients.

name: Digits
summary: AI-native general ledger with 24/7 bookkeeping and reconciliation; firms pay per client with no seat fees (US only).
useCase: Run an AI-first ledger for startup clients.

name: Karbon
summary: Practice management with AI email triage and summaries.
useCase: Triage client email and turn it into tasks.

name: Truewind
summary: AI-powered bookkeeping and close for startups and firms.

name: Botkeeper
summary: AI bookkeeping platform for firms (Infinite under Xendoo; operating again after Feb 2026 wind-down): categorization, close tracker, client hub.

name: ChatGPT (custom GPTs)
summary: General assistant used for client emails, memo drafts and spreadsheet analysis.
useCase: Draft plain-English month-end summaries for clients.

name: Financial Cents
pricing: Solo $19/mo; Team $49/user/mo; Scale $69/user/mo (annual); Month-End Close add-on $5/client/mo
summary: Workflow and client-request tool for accounting firms, with a month-end close add-on for uncategorized transactions.
useCase: Track recurring bookkeeping deadlines and chase clients for missing docs and uncategorized transactions.

name: Double (formerly Keeper)
pricing: Per-client mix-and-match plans; demo required to start
summary: Month-end close and client management layer on top of QuickBooks Online, with AI bank feeds and AI transaction review.
useCase: Review client files, flag uncategorized transactions, and get client answers before closing the month.
